goal: Enforce that wallets have only one encryption key and fail cleanly on unexpected extra key records
Simplifies wallet passphrase and unlock handling by removing dead code for multiple passphrases
agreement: Strong support for simplifying encryption handling and long-term maintainability (rkrux, davidgumberg)
Verified backward compatibility with nonstandard key IDs via testing (vicjuma)
Resolved edge case where rare blank wallets encrypted twice in old versions fail to load (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (theStack, w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it cleans up core wallet crypter code and removes unused multi-passphrase dead ends from 2011
Eliminates redundant key tracking loops and inconsistent single-key checks across wallet routines
